subject: Compact-to-Composite migration pathway — add-on sculpting and stepped upgrade options
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira.khan@novapulse.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Novapulse Procurement <procurement@novapulse.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Compact-to-Composite pathing — clarifying modular add-ons and pricing tiers

Hi Hannah / Ben,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We liked the latency and the dedicated capacity options — we think Redwood's routing and fallback story fits our needs. Procurement asked me to clarify a few things before we move to a final SOW:

1) If we start on the Compact tier and later move to Composite (higher throughput), what is the step-up discount logic? Is there a credit for unused Compact commit?
2) How are add-ons (vector-search, enhanced observability) bundled — are they toggled per-seat or per-throughput?
3) Can we buy a phased bundle: Composite core + limited vector-search pilot for 90 days, then expand?

We’ve attached a high-level master agreement draft (novapulse_MA.xlsx) and would appreciate a short written illustration of the upgrade flow and any timeline constraints. Our procurement contact is copied.

Best,
Samira Khan
Head of AI Platforms
Novapulse
[Attachment: novapulse_MA.xlsx (XLSX, 56KB)]

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@novapulse.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Compact-to-Composite pathing — clarifying modular add-ons and pricing tiers

Hi Samira — thanks for the clear list. Quick answers up front, then I’ll attach a short example flow and a matrix from our pricing team.

- Step-up credits: We offer a pro-rated credit for remaining Compact commit that can be applied toward the Composite monthly commit if the change happens within the first 180 days; after that we move to a blended-rate conversion.
- Add-ons: Vector-search and enhanced observability are metered add-ons by throughput (tokens/requests) for the Composite tier; for Compact we typically expose them as per-seat toggles with a capped throughput pilot.
- Phased bundle: Yes — we support a 90-day pilot anchored to Composite pricing with a capped pilot allowance. If you expand mid-pilot, we apply the step-up credit model above.

I’m attaching a concise flow and a sample quote draft. Ben, can you review the conversion examples and confirm the numbers? Lauren — I included you for the feature-matrix mapping.

Thanks — will set up a 30-min sync if that helps.

—
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
[hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com]
[Attachment: proposed_quote_v2.pdf (PDF, 128KB)]

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>, Samira Khan <samira.khan@novapulse.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 23 Jun 2027 08:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Compact-to-Composite pathing — clarifying modular add-ons and pricing tiers

Thanks Hannah — adding the numbers below for transparency. I’ve left out confidential internal discount bands but included the public-facing math you can use in procurement: 

Example: Compact commit = 100k tokens/day (monthly equivalent). Composite target = 300k tokens/day.
- If upgrade occurs within 90 days: remaining Compact pro-rated credit = (remaining days / 30) * monthly Compact amount. Apply to Composite monthly commit; additionally a loyalty discount of 7% on the first 3 billing cycles.
- If upgrade occurs 91–180 days: pro-rated credit applies but loyalty discount reduces to 4%.
- After 180 days: no pro-rated credit; blended-rate conversion with a 60-day transition window.

Add-on bundling note: we can allocate a fixed pilot bucket for vector-search (up to 5M vectors or X hours of processing) that increments to metered billing upon expansion. That allows you to test quality and throughput without re-committing to full add-on billing.

Happy to walk procurement through the numbers on a call.

Ben
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: none]

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@novapulse.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 24 Jun 2027 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Compact-to-Composite pathing — clarifying modular add-ons and pricing tiers

Hi Samira — I mapped features to tiers and included a recommended phased plan in the attached CSV. Highlights:

- Phase 0 (pilot, 90 days): Compact core + Vector pilot (capped) + Observability (basic)
- Phase 1 (rollout month 1–3): Composite commit at 50% initial capacity + extended observability, limited model variants
- Phase 2 (full rollforward): Composite full commit, add-on metering, optional Dedicated pool for peak windows

Attached: feature_matrix.csv with column notes on gating and prorate behavior. Also included a suggested amendment language for a step-up credit in the MA.

Action items I suggest for procurement:
- Confirm pilot cap and acceptance criteria for vector pilot (quality SLO).
- Sign 90-day amendment to lock pilot terms and step-up credit window.
- Decide on whether Dedicated pool is needed post-pilot (we can price separately).

LMK if you want me on the procurement call.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Product Operations, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: feature_matrix.csv (CSV, 9KB)]

Thanks — this is exactly the level of detail procurement wanted. Two quick clarifications before we loop legal:

1) For the 90-day pilot cap, can you make the vector-search pilot cap explicit in the SOW (e.g., 5M vectors or 1TB index, whichever comes first)?
2) For the pro-rated credit calculation, procurement expects a sample calculation in the SOW text; can you include an example line showing math for a 45-day early upgrade?

If you can add those two lines to the amendment language, we’ll push to legal and aim to sign the pilot amendment next week. Happy to do a 20-min call if easier.

Best,
Samira Khan
Head of AI Platforms
Novapulse
